catalog_fields.规则: 本条只写源文件已印出的规则。本条只写QuantifiedStrategies《Bitcoin Bollinger Bands Trading Strategy》免费Key Takeaways与正文已印句，不是会员墙正式Trading Rules小节。标的比特币；布林用20日SMA与±2标准差。Key Takeaways写：上轨突破触发做多入场；中轨交叉作为离场；只强调多头侧更有效。正式Trading Rules与做空规则段会员墙，本条不补会员正文，也不把下轨均值回归写成默认。页面写回测约2015至今；未印仓位%、手续费。提出日期取datetime首条。 不是M0184四小时布林下轨均值回归，也不是M0819 SPY布林+RSI均值回归：本条是比特币布林(20,2)收盘上破上轨做多、收盘回到中轨离场（只做多；Key Takeaways；正式Trading Rules会员墙不补）。 计入加密。 提出日期按源文件原样保留2026-01-25。

metric_conventions.base_series: 731 raw daily-close equity values including cash days, with initial100000 prepended only for returns/drawdown
metric_conventions.exposure: endclose bars quantity>0 divided by731; no intrabar inference
metric_conventions.fee_total: sum exact Decimal fees; represented decimaltext
metric_conventions.floats: Decimal values converted to float64 for numpy metrics only; no float in indicators, order eligibility, allocation, valuation
metric_conventions.monthly_counts: fills by execution UTC month; days_long=endclose quantity>0; allzero activity months retained
metric_conventions.monthly_return: month final equity/prior month final equity-1; firstdenominator100000; all24calendar months continuous, no reset
metric_conventions.roundtrip: a buy followed by a sell; netpnl=sale cash_after-entry cash_before; open trade excluded from win_rate
metric_conventions.serialization: CSV UTF8 csv.writer default CRLF; booleans0/1; missing empty; Decimal str no quantization; JSON indent2 UTF8 ensure_ascii=False allow_nan=False newline; no timestamps in deterministic results

metric_conventions.win_rate: strictly positive netpnl/closedroundtrips; zero included denominator; null if no closedtrade

name: BTC布林20/2上破/中轨退出：目录假设
reason: CATALOG_HYPOTHESIS / ADAPTED_EXECUTION_PROXY;1规则实现4固定策略配置0新control;strict0

bollinger.SMA: Current and previous19 closes; sum in chronological order/20, Decimal50.
bollinger.convention: Populationvariance and strictcross choices are explicit hypothesis, not verified formal author Trading Rules.
bollinger.variance: Population ddof0; sum((close-mean)^2) in chronological order/20, then Decimal50.sqrt(); upper=mean+2*sqrt(variance), lower=mean-2*sqrt(variance).

capital.rounding_disclosure: fee=budget-notional closes the Decimal allocation exactly. Product quantity*fill may differ by final Decimal rounding; freeze this arithmetic order, no negative-cash tolerance/clipping, no implicit reserve, no price/tick rounding.
capital.terminal: mark raw last close without forced sale or unincurred exit fees; report holdings and unexecuted intent

rules.capital_provenance: Catalog position fraction unspecified; fullcash fee-inclusive is explicitly selected hypothesis, not author rule.
rules.cold_start: 31 pre-evaluation daily bars for indicators; start allcash, no warmup intent. First evaluation close may compare prior ready feature; earliest signal-driven fill is second evaluation open.
rules.date_scope: Research2023–2024 subwindow of catalog approx2015–present, chosen by available data; source proposeddate2026-01-25 is preserved. Not OOS.
rules.entry: Previousready C<=upper and current C>upper; strict currentupcross, not persistent aboveupper entry.

at_close_sequence: Update completed-bar indicators. Compute raw entry and exit independent of holdings.
Raw opposite event cancels pending opposite intent before position gating; if both events arise exit/cancel-buy has priority.
Schedule buy only if flat and raw entry; sell only if long and raw exit.
Same-direction repeat retains original earliest due; absent event does not cancel an existing intent.
All calendar labels refer to UTC bar-open date; signal close knowledge becomes actionable at following bar open or declared lag2.
No warmup intents, equality neutral except explicit previous-side inclusive crossing condition.
execution.at_open: Execute earliest-due pending action if due_index<=currentindex and actual holdings permit. Stale is logged/discarded; no sameopen roundtrip or reentry. No out-of-window fill.
execution.lag2: Raw opposite event at t+1 cancels pending intent due t+2. Absence of event retains original intent/due, no repeated deferral.

rules.exit: Previousready C>=middle and current C<middle; strict currentdowncross; exactmiddle equality retains position.
rules.known_halt: Known2023-03-24 halt is intraday; no daily-midnight override. No general tradability claim.
rules.membership_scope: Only printed catalog long20/2breakout andmiddleexit. No membership text, shortside, lowerband meanreversion, parametersearch or authorperformance reproduction.
rules.stop_or_roi: No intrabar stop/ROI added when absent from catalog; gap risk borne by nextopen proxy.
rules.valuation: Endbar equity=cash+quantity*rawclose. No funding/interest, no dividend assumptions needed for spot BTC. No terminal liquidation or hypothetical exit fee; report residual inventory and pending action separately. No fill outside evaluation.
